text:
Zoe M: Hello team, second day here. On an M1 Air using fish. Followed the dotfiles bootstrap but hitting a couple weird things: asdf plugins installed but `layout asdf` in repo .envrc errors with 'plugin not found' until I source asdf manually. Also brew installed to /opt/homebrew but some scripts still write to /usr/local and fail. Any tips?

Rafael G: Welcome Zoe! For fish ordering matters: in `~/.config/fish/config.fish` put Homebrew PATH first, then source asdf, then direnv hook. Example: `set -gx PATH /opt/homebrew/bin $PATH` then `source ~/.asdf/asdf.fish` then `eval (direnv hook fish)`. That usually fixes the layout plugin not found.

Zoe M: That fixed layout asdf. Thanks! Now the bootstrap script tries to `brew link` to /usr/local and fails with permissions. I think I used an old Homebrew previously. How do I cleanup without breaking existing tools?

Clare H: If you have legacy stuff in /usr/local, prefer to fix permissions for only the offending dirs instead of chowning everything. Check `ls -la /usr/local` and `brew doctor`. On Apple Silicon Homebrew should be under /opt/homebrew; unlink/remove any stray formulas in /usr/local and re-install via `brew install <pkg>` which will use /opt/homebrew. Avoid running bootstrap with sudo; that causes root-owned files in your home.

Zoe M: I did run one step with sudo and now `~/.config` has root-owned files. Quickest safe fix?

Rafael G: `chown -R $USER:staff ~/.config ~/.dotfiles ~/.local` usually works. Then re-run bootstrap without sudo. Inspect any system-level changes the bootstrap made before reverting.

Zoe M: Good call. One other snag: asdf nodejs fails during `import-release-team-keyring` with gpg errors (`gpg: can't connect to the agent`) — I'm behind corp VPN/proxy. Any workaround?

Clare H: Two options: install GPG tools via brew (`brew install gnupg pinentry-mac`) and set `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` before running the script; or fetch the keys manually on a machine with internet and `gpg --import` the .asc file. If proxy blocks hkps you can curl the key over https from GitHub and import local file.

Zoe M: Manual import worked. Last q: the quickstart suggests setting `RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=native` and `CGO_ENABLED=1` but worried about portability — should I set them globally in my shell rc or in per-project .envrc?

Rafael G: Prefer per-project `.envrc` entries. Global RUSTFLAGS can cause non-portable artifacts that differ from CI. Put: `export CGO_ENABLED=1` and any RUSTFLAGS only in repos that need them. Keeps defaults consistent for teammates.

Zoe M: Awesome. Who do I ping for dotfiles sync and 1Password SSH key access? I forked the dotfiles but private hooks are missing.

Clare H: Ping ops or DM me; I'll open a ticket to add you to `redwood/new-hires/ssh` and kick off a dotfiles sync.

infra-bot: Created ticket OPS-2561 to add Zoe M to 1Password 'redwood/new-hires/ssh' and schedule dotfiles sync. :robot_face:

Zoe M: Thanks all! I'll fix perms and update fish config then report back if anything else pops up. :tada:
